description: This file defines the Settings class for writing OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) settings XML files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles exporting document and worksheet settings, including view configurations and freeze panes.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Handles writing the settings.xml content for ODS files, including document settings, worksheet views, and freeze panes.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the settings XML content for the ODS document, including view and worksheet settings.

methods.name: writeAllWorksheetSettings
methods.description: Writes settings for all worksheets in the spreadsheet, primarily used for exporting individual worksheet configurations.

methods.name: writeWorksheetSettings
methods.description: Writes configuration settings specific to a single worksheet, such as its title and freeze panes.

methods.name: writeSelectedCells
methods.description: Writes the cursor position based on the worksheet's selected cells.

methods.name: writeSplitValue
methods.description: Helper to write freeze pane and split configuration values.

methods.name: writeFreezePane
methods.description: Writes freeze pane configuration if set, translating cell address into split positions.
